_comment: The libgit2 port campaign's order of modules and its waves, schema 5, as planner run 4 planned them
over the whole target, the libgit2.so link unit and the git2 CLI executable, and planner run 5
corrected them. modules and the todo waves come from one wavefront schedule of
crustify/wavefront/configs/wavefront-config.json in its default, body-deep mode, every module's
files seeded, enums scheduled (--with-enums), no batch caps; modules are listed by layer. One
departure from wavefront's order: each foundational module's uses of other modules
(src/util/errors.c's git_error_set_oom and git_error_set on alloc.c's, strlist.c's and
win32_leakcheck.c's failure paths) are cut, so the foundational modules come first, and every layer
is the longest path over the scheduled dependencies that remain. Waves 0-168 are the wrap campaign's
that had started (88 done, 1 wip): kept as they ran, their items those of their batches, each with
its batch's kind as objective; the 17 wip waves of port modules were closed with the batches that
had landed, at the user's request. The todo waves are waves 204-1569, with no batches: run 4 planned
204-1528, and run 5 removed 29 of them and appended 1529-1569 in their place. Each item's objective
follows its module's: in the seven foundational modules, which are wrap in every campaign, the items
other modules can reach (exported and header-inline functions, extern globals, callbacks, and the
types a header declares) are wrap, their statics and enums planned for none; in every other module,
which the port campaign ports, every function, global, callback, enum and type generator is port,
and a struct or union is port where the order places it unless C of another module uses its layout
(t2/fa_with_root.csv's field accesses, and the layout_uses.ql query's, under
crustify/artifacts/planner/run-4/layout-uses/: sizeof/alignof/offsetof, values, copies, indexing,
pointer arithmetic and by-value embedding, an embedding struct's users counting for what it embeds;
tests are no users). Such a type is wrap where the order places it and port in a wave of its own
module after the last of those modules is integrated (one deferred wave per sublayer of the deferred
types, each waiting for its types' last user modules' final waves), or wrap only when one of those
users stays C in a foundational module, which none does. An item a started wave's batches hold, or
that a batch landed, with that objective is not planned again, and a dependency on it is one on that
wave. A wave's depends_on is recomputed from its items' unit edges: scheduled, its module's previous
wave and the earlier waves holding their dependencies; cut, the later ones. Out of scope: the
deprecated git_url_resolve_cb and the GIT_DEPRECATE_HARD-only anchors (commit_id, signing_cb,
resolve_url, update_tips). A module's external records count its units' references to out-of-tree
entities, macros and compiler builtins left out, by the library whose installed headers define them.
Homes follow the conventions: src/<link-unit>/<TU path>.rs, a header module's <stem>_h.rs.
